linear.gfa.purpose: Three segments in a chain with dp, DP and KC depth tags: N50, GC and depth rules.

bgzf.gfa.gz.purpose: A graph in BGZF blocks (bgzip): block-by-block reading.

two_members.gfa.gz.purpose: Two concatenated gzip members: multi-member reading.

circle.gfa.purpose: Three segments joined into a circle: no dead ends, circular component.

circle.fastg.purpose: A FASTG circle, as SPAdes writes it.

bubble.gfa.purpose: A bubble: one segment forks into two and rejoins.

bubble.fastg.purpose: The bubble in FASTG, with reverse-complement records.

tip.gfa.purpose: A chain with a dead-end tip.

tangle.gfa.purpose: A tangle with three entries and three exits.

two_components.gfa.purpose: Two components of different length: ranking by total length.

palindrome.gfa.purpose: A palindromic link (a + a -) joining one end to itself.

mirror_links.gfa.purpose: Links written twice, once as each mirror: deduplication.

forward_refs.gfa.purpose: Links and paths that name segments defined later in the file, and one that is never defined.

star_ln.gfa.purpose: Segments with * sequence and LN length tags, and one with neither.

paths.gfa.purpose: GFA 1.1: P lines, W walks, C and J records, comments.

colour_tags.gfa.purpose: CL, LB, cl, C2 and L2 tags, valid and invalid.

malformed.gfa.purpose: Bad tags, short lines and bad numbers: each becomes a parse warning.

malformed.fastg.purpose: Broken FASTG headers: each becomes a parse warning.

reverse_only.fastg.purpose: A FASTG segment known only from its reverse-complement record.

gfa2.gfa.purpose: GFA 2.0, which GRAPE rejects with a message.

abyss.gfa.purpose: Two segments with * sequence and a link, for adding sequences from a FASTA file.

abyss.fa.purpose: The two sequences that go with abyss.gfa.

search.gfa.purpose: Random-base segments with a 25 base overlap, a SNP bubble, a link of unknown overlap and a two-segment chain: sequence search and joining across links.

csgA.fasta.purpose: The csgA gene of Myxococcus xanthus DK 1622, 690 bases: the known-gene search check against myxococcus-10-assemblies.gfa.gz (a data/samples file).
